prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website homepage direction preview, landscape 1440-by-1000 proportions.
Primary request: Design a practical political campaign homepage for Julia Adele Callahan using a disciplined Swiss concert-poster grid translated into civic information. It must be a website viewport, not a poster photograph or design board. The campaign facts replace all music-event content. Honor the football theme through field bars and the supplied headline.
Structure: one thin top navigation band with joinjulia.com and My story / Priorities. A large modular opening grid contains a narrow left navigation/identity rail, a dominant central typographic column with Democrats on offense as the biggest headline and Julia Adele Callahan as the unmistakable candidate, a smaller For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair line and a blue Explore the priorities control, and a right column with four issue rows, complete labels, and typographic arrow links. One saturated blue geometric field module punctuates the center, with simple white field bars; it supports the headline rather than overpowering it. Below the opening grid, show the start of a My story section with How my business started and My journey into politics. The full four-topic index remains readable.
Palette and system: matte light ground #F2F2F0, flat black #0A0A0A, saturated signal blue #153FE8. Objective strong grotesk typography, flush-left/ragged-right text, size steps from one modular grid, crisp rules, square controls. Active topic state is a blue bar and stronger type weight. No music facts, dates, tickets, or newsletter forms.
Text verbatim: joinjulia.com; My story; Priorities; Democrats on offense; Julia Adele Callahan; For Bibb County Democratic Party Chair; Explore the priorities; 01; Jail & public safety reform; 02; Election accessibility; 03; Healthcare; 04; Education; How my business started; My journey into politics.
Constraints: no invented policy details, endorsements, dates, statistics, donations, portraits, testimonials, or event claims. No fake likeness of Julia, no stock crowd, no gradients, glows, card shells, browser frame, or watermark. Preserve the football campaign identity and make the reading action obvious. Numbering is navigation rather than importance ranking.
